mapper.select: SELECT p.policy_id AS policyId, p.policy_name AS policyName, p.policy_summary AS policySummary, p.department_name AS departmentName, p.begin_date AS beginDate, p.end_date AS endDate, COALESCE(psc.scrap_count, 0) AS bookmarkCount FROM policies p INNER JOIN business_info bi ON bi.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN policy_scrap_counts psc ON p.policy_id = psc.policy_id WHERE (p.region_id IS NULL AND p.industry_id IS NULL) OR p.region_id = bi.region_id OR p.industry_id = bi.industry_id ORDER BY bookmarkCount DESC, p.end_date ASC
